title: Month 1, Week 2 (Nov 15 – Nov 21, 2026): Pediatric/Circumscribed Gliomas, Ependymomas, Cytogenetics & Embryonal/Meningiomas

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Draw the WHO CNS5 Adult Diffuse Glioma IHC/Molecular algorithm from memory.
Reading (75m): WHO CNS5 — Pediatric-Type Diffuse Gliomas (Diffuse Midline Glioma H3 K27-altered, Diffuse Hemispheric Glioma H3 G34-mutant [OLIG2-!]) & Circumscribed Astrocytic Gliomas (Pilocytic Astrocytoma KIAA1549::BRAF, PXA BRAF V600E + CDKN2A/B, SEGA TSC1/2).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 CNS slides @ 3m/case (Pilocytic astrocytoma biphasic pattern/Rosenthal fibers, PXA, SEGA, DMG).
QBank (30m): 15 CNS Pediatric/Circumscribed Glioma MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry comparing Rosenthal Fibers (Pilocytic, Alexander disease, chronic piloid gliosis) vs. Eosinophilic Granular Bodies (Pilocytic, PXA, Ganglioglioma).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall molecular signatures of Pilocytic Astrocytoma, PXA, SEGA, and DMG.
Reading (75m): WHO CNS5 — Glioneuronal & Neuronal Tumors (Ganglioglioma, DNET, Central/Extraventricular Neurocytoma, Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor) & Ependymal Tumors (Supratentorial ZFTA vs. YAP1, Posterior Fossa PFA/PFB, Spinal MYCN, Myxopapillary [Gr 2], Subependymoma [Gr 1]).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 CNS slides @ 3m/case (DNET floating neurons, Ganglioglioma, Ependymoma perivascular pseudorosettes, Myxopapillary ependymoma, Subependymoma).
QBank (20m): 15 CNS MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 2 (True Rosettes vs. Pseudorosettes & Ependymoma Compartments) and log EMA paranuclear dot-like positivity vs. OLIG2 negativity in Ependymoma.

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the 5 CNS rosette types (Homer Wright, Flexner-Wintersteiner, True Ependymal, Perivascular Pseudorosette, Pineocytomatous) and their tumors.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Slides: 6 CNS Glioneuronal/Ependymal slides (3m/case) + 4 Thyroid FNA slides (Bethesda Cat IV Follicular/Oncocytic Neoplasm, Cat V, Cat VI PTC @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 CNS & Thyroid Cyto MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Record a 2-min spoken SOE script on Posterior Fossa pediatric tumor workup (H3K27me3 nuclear loss occurs in BOTH PF-A Ependymoma and H3 K27-altered DMG!).

days.b1: Secondary System — Cytogenetics, FISH & Microarrays (90m): SCFHS Curriculum Molecular Table — Karyotyping, FISH/CISH probe types (centromeric repeat-sequence, whole-chromosome painting, locus-specific dual-fusion vs. break-apart), CGH, SNP microarray (copy-neutral LOH), & MSI/MMR testing.
days.b2: QBank & Images (30m): 15 Cytogenetics/FISH MCQs + 5 FISH/EM images (1p/19q codeletion, break-apart vs. fusion signals).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Review One-Pager 3 (FISH Probe Architecture & MSI/MMR Discordance Troubleshooting).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Ependymoma anatomic-molecular compartments and FISH break-apart vs. dual-fusion interpretation.
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 CNS/Cytogenetics + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on CNS & FISH).
Deep Review (45m): Analyze recall question stems.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed CNS & FISH recall pitfalls to the 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 2 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 2 progress to GitHub.

days.b1: Primary System Deep Dive — Neuropathology II (2.5h): WHO CNS5 — Embryonal Tumors (Medulloblastoma 4 molecular groups: WNT, SHH TP53-wt/mut, Non-WNT/Non-SHH; AT/RT SMARCB1/INI1 or SMARCA4/BRG1 loss; ETMR C19MC), Pineal, Choroid Plexus, & Meningiomas (Grades 1–3 morphologic + molecular criteria).
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 CNS Spot Slides @ 3m/case (Medulloblastoma variants, AT/RT, Choroid plexus papilloma vs. carcinoma, Meningioma variants) + 25 MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Master One-Pager 2 (Medulloblastoma 4-Group IHC Table & Meningioma WHO Grade 1–3 Criteria: 4–19 vs. ≥20 mitoses/10 HPF, brain invasion, chordoid/clear cell, TERTp mut, CDKN2A/B hom del).
